question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only J sits to the left of O. Only four people sit between J and I. Only K sits between M and N, and M is not an immediate neighbor of I. Who sits at the extreme right of the line?
solution:
Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only J sits to the left of O.
 
• Only four people sit between J and I.
 
• Only K sits between M and N, and M is not an immediate neighbor of I
